title: Skin Care for Mumbai Weather: A Light Routine for Humidity, Monsoon and October Heat
ex: Humid air most of the year, a heavy June to September monsoon, October heat and a short mild winter: how to keep a light skin care routine for Mumbai weather.
rt: Skin Care for Mumbai Weather: Humid-City Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Mumbai weather: light moisturiser, daily sunscreen, the heavy monsoon, October heat, oily skin, train commutes and AC offices, made simple.
quick: Mumbai is humid most of the year with a heavy monsoon from about June to September, so skin does best with a light moisturiser, a broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning even on rainy days, and a proper night cleanse. Use a thin layer of night cream and keep the T-zone light.
facts: Mumbai's monsoon runs roughly June to September
The winter is short and mild
Oily skin can still be dehydrated
